Hyundai’s smart mobility strategy rests on three foundational pillars:
Shared Mobility
(car-sharing and ride-hailing services),
Connected Mobility
(integrated digital and connected-car ecosystems), and
Clean Mobility
(eco-friendly electric and hydrogen fuel-cell vehicles)
EQ Mag Pro
Core Pillars Explained
Shared Mobility:
Investments and platforms for car-sharing and ride-hailing to reduce individual vehicle ownership and urban congestion.
EQ Mag Pro
Connected Mobility:
Advanced in-car connectivity, over-the-air (OTA) updates, and smart device integration linking cars to workplaces and homes.
EQ Mag Pro
Clean Mobility:
Zero-emission transportation powered by battery electric vehicles (BEVs) and hydrogen fuel-cell electric vehicles (FCEVs)
